acquisition method: the data-dependent top10 method was used to acquire MS data.
cleavage agent: proteins were digested with trypsin using in-gel digestion
enrichment method: the total membrane fraction was isolated
fractionation method: the membrane fractions (200 μg) were run on a 10% SDS-PAGE
instrument: analyzed using the Orbitrap mass spectrometer... coupled to the QExactive mass spectrometer
labeling: Furthermore, through label-free quantitative membrane proteome analysis
reduction reagent: 2 mM dithiothreitol (DTT)... protein samples were reduced with TCEP solution
